subject.title: feat(gateway): watched sessions in presence with viewer facepiles

question: Should watched-session identifiers be visible to pairing and node recipients, or must the gateway expose them only through an `operator.read`-authorized/redacted presence projection?
rationale: Current presence delivery and session-read authorization have different recipient scopes, so the acceptable projection contract cannot safely be inferred from this feature patch alone.

options.title: Scope watched-session presence
options.body: Expose raw watched-session keys only to recipients authorized to read sessions, while retaining an appropriately redacted presence shape for other clients.

options.title: Pause viewer exposure
options.body: Hold the feature until maintainers define a durable presence privacy contract that covers pairing, nodes, and future clients.

recommendation.title: Scope watched-session presence
recommendation.body: Expose raw watched-session keys only to recipients authorized to read sessions, while retaining an appropriately redacted presence shape for other clients.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged identity-presence foundation and the linked shared-gateway identity program that this PR extends.
